story.title: Connecting Global Sourcing Partners with Vietnam's Premier Manufacturing & Industrial Excellence.
story.body: The Vietnam Trade Promotion Agency (VIETRADE — Cục Xúc tiến thương mại) is the premier governmental authority operating under the Ministry of Industry and Trade of Vietnam (MOIT). VIETRADE spearheads state trade promotion, national export acceleration, foreign investment linkages, and the prestigious Vietnam National Brand program (Vietnam Value / Thương hiệu Quốc gia). Heading the official Vietnamese trade delegation at Trade Expo Indonesia (TEI 2026), VIETRADE establishes direct, high-trust bridges between international importers, sovereign procurement authorities, and accredited Vietnamese producers across specialty coffee, agricultural commodities, consumer electronics, and sustainable bio-materials.

vietnamValue.title: Chương trình Thương hiệu Quốc gia Việt Nam (Vietnam Value)
vietnamValue.description: Approved directly by the Prime Minister and chaired by the Minister of Industry and Trade, Vietnam Value is the nation's highest accreditation for enterprise excellence. Participating enterprises represent the pinnacle of Vietnamese industry across three non-negotiable criteria:

pillars.title: Chất lượng (Quality)
pillars.desc: Rigorous compliance with stringent global technical standards, ISO/FDA accreditations, and zero-defect quality control.

pillars.title: Đổi mới, Sáng tạo (Innovation)
pillars.desc: Continuous technological modernization, automated manufacturing, and domestic research & development capabilities.

pillars.title: Năng lực tiên phong (Pioneering Capacity)
pillars.desc: Market leadership, sustainable governance, and capacity to represent Vietnamese commercial pride globally.

highlights.title: Bilateral Trade & Sourcing Delegations
highlights.body: Facilitating structured B2B matchmaking, trade missions, and high-trust procurement channels between international buyers and certified Vietnamese manufacturers.

highlights.title: Vietnam National Brand (Vietnam Value)
highlights.body: Overseeing the national brand development program, certifying premier enterprises that champion quality, innovation, and sustainable export standards.

highlights.title: Trade Fairs & Global Exhibitions
highlights.body: Organizing Vietnam's signature international trade exhibitions—including Vietnam Expo and Vietnam Foodexpo—and coordinating official overseas trade pavilions.
